# Animationclub School

> > Online animation school offering affordable, industry-focused training in traditional 2D animation, character animation, and body mechanics.

Founded by professionals from studios like Disney, Gobelins, and CalArts, Animationclub School provides mentorship-driven courses teaching traditional animation principles using tools like Toon Boom Harmony. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on learning inspired by productions such as Klaus, Wolfwalkers, and Primal.

## Key Topics

- Traditional 2D Animation
- Character Animation
- Body Mechanics
- Animation Mentorship
- 12 Principles of Animation
- Toon Boom Harmony
- Acting for Animation
- Clean-up Techniques
- Disney Animation
- Klaus
- Christian Maymo
- Short Film Production
- Visual Development
- Gobelins
- CalArts

## Getting Started

- [Animationclub School](https://animationclub.school): Homepage for online animation school offering affordable industry training
- [Courses - Animationclub School](https://animationclub.school/courses): Main courses page featuring 2D animation, body mechanics, and mentorship

## Core Courses

- [Traditional 2D animation. Course 1 — Basics - Animationclub School](https://animationclub.school/courses/traditional-2d-animation-basics): Beginner course covering 12 principles and traditional 2D animation basics
- [Traditional 2D animation. Clean Up Workshop: Free Start - Animationclub School](https://animationclub.school/courses/clean-up-workshop-free-start): Free 2D animation clean-up workshop using Toon Boom Harmony with C. Maymo
